_doc: Jev questions for the FunctionGemma sample contract. area: option key -> the Korean criterion sentence the head scores against (its mean layer-12 state is the option vector, so criteria can be re-declared without retraining the trunk) and the contract functions it covers; DefaultResponse belongs to `none`. noul: is the utterance an executable command at all.

music.criterion: 음악을 틀거나 멈추거나 음량을 바꾸는 명령

none.criterion: 지원하지 않거나 모호하거나 두 가지 동작이 섞인, 실행하지 않을 말
